frame_count.description: Display the requested number of frames, then quit (-f). 0 means infinite loop.

min_rows.description: Crop the animation from the top (-r). Number of rows to skip.

max_rows.description: Crop the animation from the bottom (-R). Number of rows to skip.

min_cols.description: Crop the animation from the left (-c). Number of columns to skip.

max_cols.description: Crop the animation from the right (-C). Number of columns to skip.

width.description: Crop the animation to the given width (-W). 0 means full width.

height.description: Crop the animation to the given height (-H). 0 means full height.

show_intro.description: Show introduction / about information on startup (-i). If false, skips intro (-I).

no_title.description: Do not set the titlebar text (-s).

no_clear.description: Do not clear the display between frames (-e).
